description: §6.7.4 EC-1 — a `when` dep-list entry that names a `const <name>` derived cell is E-LIFECYCLE-007. A derived cell has no change event of its own; list the mutable @variables it is computed from instead.
rationale: §6.7.4 Edge Case EC-1 + Normative Statements + §34: the compiler SHALL emit E-LIFECYCLE-007 if any dep-list entry names a `const <name>` derived variable. With the dep-list subscription (a derived cell is never written) the body would otherwise silently never fire.
